title: Sightmap v1
description: A sightmap file: one YAML document under .sightmap/ describing views, components, requests, and memory entries. See https://github.com/sightmap/sightmap/blob/main/spec/v1/schema.md for the human-readable reference.

version.description: Must be 1 for files that conform to this version of the spec.

url.description: File-level default representative URL, applied to every view in this file that does not declare its own. See the per-view `url`.

memory.description: File-level memory entries — surfaced whenever any definition from this file is active.

components.description: Global components — matched against every view. Entries may be either inline definitions or {"$ref": ComponentName} reference objects (see SEP-0002).

requests.description: Global requests — matched against every view.

memory.description: Freeform notes surfaced to agents at runtime in the [Guide] section.

selector.description: A CSS selector, or a list of alternative selectors tried in order.

route.description: Glob pattern matched against the URL pathname. * matches one segment, ** matches any depth.

url.description: Representative URL for this view: a concrete address that resolves to it, used by tooling to navigate to the view (report, capture --all, sel-probe --all, discover). Falls back to the file-level `url` when omitted.

dependencies.description: Optional list of supplementary files (minimatch globs, '!' negation, project-root-anchored) whose changes should trigger re-curation of this view. See spec/v1/schema.md#dependencies for semantics.

components.description: View-scoped components. Entries may be either inline definitions or {"$ref": ComponentName} reference objects (see SEP-0002).

componentOrRef.description: Either an inline component definition or a reference object {"$ref": ComponentName}. See SEP-0002.

componentRef.description: A reference to a component defined at file root in any sightmap file. Expanded inline before matching. See SEP-0002.

$ref.description: The name of a component defined at file root in any loaded sightmap file.

dependencies.description: Optional list of supplementary files (minimatch globs, '!' negation, project-root-anchored) whose changes should trigger re-curation of this component. See spec/v1/schema.md#dependencies for semantics.

properties.description: Ordered list of DOM-value extractions surfaced in enriched snapshot output. See SEP-0003.

children.description: Nested components. Selectors are scoped to the parent's matched subtree. Entries may be either inline definitions or {"$ref": ComponentName} reference objects (see SEP-0002).

componentProperty.description: A named DOM-value extraction from a matched element. See SEP-0003.

name.description: Key used in the snapshot annotation (name="value"). The name 'value' is reserved: it may be declared to override the AX built-in, but SDKs treat 'value' as the AX-value fallback even without a declaration.

extract.description: Extraction directive: text | inner_text | text_only | inner_html | attr=NAME | exists:SEL | a CSS sub-selector. See SEP-0003 Extract modes.

transform.description: Optional post-processing applied to the extracted string.

route.description: Glob pattern. Express-style :param segments normalize to *.

method.description: HTTP method filter. Case-insensitive; commonly GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE.
